title: Piclidenoson for the treatment of Lowe Syndrome
official: An open-label, phase 2 pilot study on the efficacy and safety of Piclidenoson in patients with Lowe syndrome
summary:
Main objective: Evaluate the efficacy of piclidenoson to increase renal uptake of 99mTclabeled DMSA, in comparison to baseline, after 6 months (26 weeks) of
treatment as a measure the reabsorption capacity of LMWPs by renal proximal tubules.
